sources.title: README.md · mlboydaisuke/SAM2-hiera-tiny-LiteRT at main
sources.snippet: SAM 2.1 (Segment Anything 2, Meta) Hiera-Tiny converted to LiteRT and running fully on the GPU via the CompiledModel API (ML Drift). Tap a point on an image and it returns a segmentation mask — the image encoder runs once per image, the mask decoder runs per point.
